import React, { useState } from "react"; import { showSuccess, showError } from "../components/Notification"; const DonorScheduling = () => { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ donorName: "", mobile: "", email: "", bloodGroup: "", date: "", time: "", hospital: "", city: "", message: "", }); const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]; const handleChange = (e) => { setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value, }); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(formData.mobile)) { showError("Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number."); return; } const appointments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("donorAppointments")) || []; const newAppointment = { id: Date.now(), ...formData, status: "Pending", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; appointments.push(newAppointment); localStorage.setItem( "donorAppointments", JSON.stringify(appointments) ); showSuccess("Donation appointment submitted successfully!"); setFormData({ donorName: "", mobile: "", email: "", bloodGroup: "", date: "", time: "", hospital: "", city: "", message: "", }); }; return (
